chunks: (Moses) said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, if you can believe."
ai.seo_question: Who is speaking in the verse 'The Lord of the heavens and the earth' in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse is part of Prophet Moses' (AS) dialogue with Pharaoh, where he challenges the tyrant's claim to divinity by asserting Allah's absolute sovereignty over the cosmos. The phrase 'if you are believers' serves as a logical test: if Pharaoh truly possesses divine power, he should be able to recreate the heavens and earth or restore the soul, thereby proving his status as a god.
